adjudication.rationale: Verified in `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`: it iterates `usernames.split(",")`, does `User.find_by_username(username)` and only `group.add(user)` if found; missing usernames are ignored. Regardless, it returns `success_json` when `group.save` succeeds, so the caller can’t distinguish full success from partial/no-op adds. This is an API/UX semantics concern rather than a clear defect mandated by the diff (the UI can still refresh and show unchanged members).
